Callback: AWS already names its acts, clientcertificate:update, and our preview turned them into forms. Here, one name per act, the same on both forges: scm: typed relations. One client, one script, either forge.
say: The callback. AWS already names its acts as typed relations: clientcertificate:update. The preview turned them into forms. Can we do the same for two forges that never agreed: one name per act, the same on both, so one client and one script work on either? The answer the next slides show: yes, with the scm: prefix, one YAML connector per forge, and HEART on top.
